SOURCE: wave `block-pdrn-research-mechanism-r2`, slot `pdrn-r2-t2i--A-two-changes`, Nano Banana Pro candidate 01, from the reference-free (t2i) route. Class B — no product in frame, no brand identity supplied to any engine. Master 4096x4096.

THREE ROUNDS TO GET HERE. r1 put the two mechanisms in as discrete PEARL BLOBS — a cupped receptor granule, a rounded cell among the fibres. Malcolm chose the A-family nbp_pro_01 frame and asked for both blobs to go: 'in the first layer of skin - lets show the active effect slightly enlarging the small balls - and making them glow (not showing a pearl sphere)' and 'in the second deeper layer of skin - show the active effect mending broken strands and making the strands thicker and making them glow (not showing pearl spheres)'. r2 ran that as two routes, an edit from his chosen frame and a fresh text-to-image, and he picked from the fresh route.

VERIFIED AT NATIVE PIXELS BEFORE UPLOAD, not from a contact sheet:
  - NO PEARL BLOB in either layer. The change is carried by the tissue that is already there.
  - GRANULES: at each of the two arrival points the small round granules are visibly larger and lit from
    within, easing back to ordinary size and unlit toward the sides. Slight and local, as asked.
  - FIBRES: strands thicker, denser and glowing where the light lands, thinner and plainer away from it,
    one continuous gradient. Fine bright filaments at the arrival.
  - LADDERS CLOSED: two full parallel rows of pearls joined by five crossbars, ends closed, flat and
    untwisted. The COMB fault in the r1 frame — one rail with teeth — is gone.
  - NO HOLLOW TUBE ENDS. Every strand runs continuous; there is no cut-pipe end anywhere. This mattered:
    the r2 EDIT route produced exactly that fault, because asking for broken strands creates ends and
    every engine in this family draws a fibre end as an open bore. The t2i frame Malcolm chose sidesteps
    it by showing thickening and glow without drawing explicit breaks — which is also the safer reading
    against this page's hedged copy.

SQUARE MASTER, MEASURED NOT ASSUMED. The f2 box live on 2026-08-27: 660x660 (1.000) at 1440, 580x580 at 1280, 540x621 (0.870) at 1200, 490x549 (0.893) at 1100, 452x573 (0.789) at 1024, 704x704 at 768, 350x350 at 390. Square at desktop and phone, stretching only in the 1000-1250 band where `cover` takes up to 10.5% off each side. A square master is therefore correct — a taller one would push this row past its five siblings. The block sits centred with clear hazy margin either side, so the 1024 crop takes background, not subject.

HANDEDNESS: `alternate_media_position` is true and f2 is the second block, so this renders image-RIGHT with text to its left. Confirmed in the live DOM, not inferred.

OPTIMISATION, MEASURED NOT ASSUMED: long edge capped at 3000 — the widest the theme's srcset ever requests — quality 95, 4:4:4, progressive, metadata stripped, and deliberately NOT compressed harder. Shopify's CDN transcodes to WebP and resizes per srcset, so the source JPEG is never what a visitor downloads; pre-compressing hands the WebP encoder artefacts to reproduce, which measured SLOWER on 2026-08-24 (974KB page before, 979KB after a 41% smaller source).

SEO FILENAME: `skingenetix-pdrn-sodium-dna-nucleotide-skin-renewal-diagram.jpg` — 63 characters, eight keywords, lowercase and hyphenated, carrying the ingredient (PDRN), its INCI name (Sodium DNA) and the mechanism the copy describes (nucleotide, skin renewal). No word from the no-search-value list.

NEW FILENAME, NEVER A RE-UPLOAD. Shopify suffixes a colliding name rather than replacing it, so re-using a name keeps serving the OLD image — that has bitten this project three times. This name is new to the store.
